caption: The drawing depicts a single white dress with short, puffed sleeves, a square neckline, and an empire waist. The neckline and sleeve edges are accentuated with a zigzag or lace trim. The bodice features a fitted upper section with a v-shaped seam under the bust and is decorated with a row of small dark dots just below the bust line. The skirt is long and flows down to the ankles, with soft vertical folds indicated by subtle gray and lavender shading. At the hem of the skirt, there is a wide band of ornate, dark embroidery with a swirling floral motif. The background is plain and off-white, making the dress the sole focus of the composition. The initials "L. LERUGE. 77." are inscribed in small text at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Day Dress (back view)
